notes.title: Patch Notes 1.7.2
notes.notes:
Hello travellers,

[b]A new update is live![/b] 

It brings important fixes and improvements to enhance your Ticket to Ride experience across all platforms. From better notifications to AI and multiplayer stability fixes, here’s what’s new:

[h3]Fixes and improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*] iOS and Android players now get native notifications at the start of their turn in asynchronous and unlimited OWF
[*] Fixed a bug causing games to freeze during the end-game sequence
[*] Games should now show under the correct "your turn" or "waiting" tabs
[*] End Game Scoring improvements
[*] Async lobbies will now start automatically when the lobby is full, even if the host is away
[*] Fixed a bug causing a freeze when there are no available moves
[*] USA Mega Game ticket scores fixed to match the physical game
[*] Console lobbies can now auto-start
[*] AI fixes and improvements
[*] Several visual improvements
[*] Several multiplayer and stability fixes
[*] Several other bug fixes
[/list]
As usual, a huge thanks to the community for reporting issues and suggesting improvements. We couldn't do it without you!

Let us know if you run into any problems. We’re continuously working to improve your experience and make Ticket to Ride the best game it can be!

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.6.2
notes.notes:
Hello Travelers! 🚂

We’re rolling out update 1.6.2 with a host of fixes to smooth out your Ticket to Ride experience. 

Here’s what’s been addressed in this patch:

🛠️ [b]Bug Fixes & Improvements:[/b]
[list]
[*] No more duplicate tickets appearing in certain games, especially in US Mega.
[*] Completing tickets in Big Cities Europe will no longer freeze the game.
[*] Corrected souvenir counts in San Francisco games for more accurate gameplay.
[*] The Sea Lion Souvenir is still shy, but it won't hide behind trains anymore!
[*] Lobbies will now start correctly after all players are ready. No more waiting around!
[*] San Francisco souvenirs sharing the same route will no longer fight for the same counter.
[*] Improved tunnel animations for a smoother visual experience.
[*] Several improvements to iOS crashing issues.
[*] AI behaviour has been polished, and some inconsistencies have been addressed.
[/list]

Thank you for your feedback and patience as we continue improving the game!

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.5.1
notes.notes:
Hello travellers!

We're excited to bring you our latest update, and we want to thank you for your ongoing support and valuable feedback. With your help, we're continuing to improve the game and ensure the best experience for everyone. Please keep the feedback coming—your input helps us make Ticket to Ride even better!

Here’s what’s new in this update:

[h2]🗺️ New Map Selection Screen[/h2]
We’ve redesigned the map selection screen to make it more intuitive and user-friendly, allowing you to quickly find your preferred maps and game modes. All aboard for a smoother journey! 🌍 

[h2]🛠️ Bug Fixes and Improvements:[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Ticket Discarding Rules Revised:[/b]
[list][*] We’ve fine-tuned the ticket discarding rules across all maps, ensuring a more accurate gameplay experience. Now, your game will follow the correct rules, either when discarding ticket cards or when placing them at the bottom of the deck![/list][*] [b]Back Button Improvement:[/b]
[list][*] In the online lobbies, the Back button will now correctly take you back to the map selection screen instead of the main menu, making it easier to explore other routes without unnecessary detours.[/list][*] [b]Turn Timer Freeze Issue Resolved:[/b]
[list][*] Letting the timer run out while selecting tickets should no longer freeze the game or cause player info to disappear.[/list][*] [b]Android Loading Screen Issue Fixed:[/b]
[list][*] No more getting stuck on the loading screen when playing on Android! We’ve addressed the issue, so you can hop right into your next game without delay.[/list][/list]
Thank you again for being part of the Ticket to Ride community. We look forward to hearing more from you as we continue to roll out new updates and release more expansions. Take care, and enjoy!


https://store.steampowered.com/app/2477010/Ticket_to_Ride/

notes.title: Patch Version 1.4.3
notes.notes:
Greetings, travellers!

The team has been hard at work making fixes and improvements to your favourite train-adventure game. Here’s what is changing in Patch 1.4.3! 

[b]Bug fixes and improvements: [/b]
[list]
[*] Missing player statistics now added (favourite colour, favourite character and favourite locomotive/carriage)
[*] Endgame failsafe implemented – if, for any reason, the leaderboards fail, players will no longer get stuck on that screen
[*] Players can now see their rank (not just the top 10).  We have also fixed the "You're not on the leaderboards" message
[/list]
We appreciate your ongoing feedback! Please keep reporting any issues or suggestions you may have to help us further improve the game via the Steam Community Hub, Discord or help@marmalademail.com.

notes.title: Patch Version 1.4.2: Hall of Fame, Player Stats and More!
notes.notes:
[h3]Hello travellers![/h3]
We have some exciting updates for you! Here’s a quick overview of what’s new and what’s coming soon:

[h2]What’s New[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Improved Train Placement Animation:[/b] Enjoy smoother and more intuitive animations for placing trains!
[*] [b]New In-Game Notifications[/b]: Stay informed with a dedicated notifications button for important game updates. 
[*] [b]Hall of Fame:[/b] Celebrate your achievements with our new Hall of Fame feature, which tracks your performance across seasons. See how you stack up and revisit your proudest moments. Data from Season 1 and Season 2 will be preserved, ensuring your past achievements remain intact!
[*] [b]Stats Page:[/b] Track your Ticket to Ride numbers, from your longest Win Streak to your Total Time Played. More stats to be added in an upcoming update!
[*] [b]Invite Friends Button:[/b] Play with friends in online and asynchronous game modes.
[*] [b]Several Bug Fixes.[/b]
[/list]
[h2]Game Translated in PT-BR[/h2]
Our players said, 'Come to Brazil', and we did! The game is now available in Brazilian Portuguese! Now even more players can join us as we aim to better serve our amazing global community. 

Which languages do you think Ticket to Ride should be translated into next?

[h2]Roadmap 2024[/h2]
We’ve updated our 2024 roadmap with more features and expansions coming this year. For detailed information on what’s ahead, be sure to check it out here.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44633384/e69880fee336761a7a900848401fdf6335be0358.png[/img] 

Thank you for your continued enthusiasm and support! Your feedback means the world to us, so don’t hesitate to share your thoughts and connect with us and other players via our [url=https://discord.gg/WNzKADrcWH]Discord[/url] server. 


Cheers,
Community Team

notes.title: Patch Version 1.3.1
notes.notes:
Greetings, travellers! 

Our team continues to work on improving and refining the game as we draw closer to our next expansion. Here's what changed in this update:

[h3]Bug fixes and improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*] A much smoother PnP experience, players can claim tunnels without any crashes. 
[*] Friend invites now work inside lobbies.
[*] The station icon on the Europe map now displays correctly when completing a ticket.
[*] Players are able to create a Bubble account without any visual issues.
[*] The default card back should no longer appear when drawing cards.
[*] Various translation issues have been fixed.
[*] The "Maximum number of Single Player saves" error now redirects you to the correct games tab.
[*] Crashes should occur less frequently now.
[*] The game will now start automatically a few seconds after all players are ready.
[/list]
We appreciate your ongoing feedback! Please keep reporting any issues or suggestions you may have to help us further improve the game via the Steam Community Hub, [url=https://discord.com/invite/v7HJG7pkTR]Discord[/url] or help@marmalademail.com.

notes.title: All Aboard: Ticket to Ride Mac Update is here!
notes.notes:
Hello travellers,

The railway adventure sprawls across to more platforms! Strategise, build your railway empire and conquer new horizons right from your Mac devices with our new update. 

To all our Mac players who have been eagerly awaiting this moment: thank you for your patience and feedback and for sticking with us as we fine-tuned and optimised the game to ensure the best possible experience for you.

Our multiplayer fun is now bigger and better than ever before – connect with friends, family and fellow enthusiasts across different devices. Enjoy the game on your Mac, and challenge opponents playing on Windows, iOS or Android with cross-play (and the list is growing soon!).

notes.title: Patch Version 1.2.4
notes.notes:
Hello travellers,

Today, we’re rolling out our latest patch update, which not only brings visibility improvements to the game across all platforms but also addresses stability and performance. This update includes:

[b]Map Visibility Improvements (Phase 1):[/b]
[list]
[*] Adjusted camera framing for all screen sizes to provide a closer view of the map
[*] Enhanced train and track visibility
[*] Improvements to city names for increased readability
[*] General improvements to the map to increase clarity
[/list]This is just Phase 1 of our map visibility improvements, and it is just the beginning! Phase 2 will be released imminently and it will bring a brand new map view to the game. Stay tuned!

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Changed the "Quit" button to "Resign" for clarity when leaving the game permanently. Thank you for raising this!
[*] Fixed a bug that could cause the game to get stuck if a player's timer expired when there were no cards to pick up
[*] Fixed a bug that would sometimes cause the game to get stuck after changing your screen resolution
[*] Fixed several stability issues caused by edge cases
[/list]
We appreciate your ongoing feedback! Please keep reporting any issues or suggestions you may have to help us further improve the game via the Community Hub, [url=https://discord.com/invite/v7HJG7pkTR]Discord[/url] or help@marmalademail.com.

notes.title: Patch Version 1.2.0
notes.notes:
Greetings, travellers!

In this update, we’ve introduced the [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2856300/Ticket_to_Ride__Nordic_Expansion/]Nordic DLC[/url][/b] 🎉, expanding your Ticket to Ride adventures to the breathtaking landscapes of the Nordic countries.

But wait, there's more! 

We've also fixed these bugs to make your journey even smoother:
[list]
[*] Fixed not being able to zoom the map on certain devices.
[*] Fixed train cards being hidden behind the player panel when your opponent claims a route.
[*] Fixed an issue with resuming a game partway through claiming a tunnel.
[*] Fixed the skip button being partially offscreen at the start and end of a game.
[/list]
Thanks for being part of our adventure and helping us identify any issues so we can tackle them as soon as possible! As we continue to work on improving your experience, we welcome your feedback in the Steam community, [url=https://discord.com/invite/8HsaNapn6d]Discord[/url] or help@marmalademail.com.

notes.title: Patch Version 1.1.2
notes.notes:
Hello, travellers! 

Our team has been working tirelessly behind the scenes to bring you the latest improvements and enhancements to your favourite railway adventure. Today, we are thrilled to share Ticket to Ride Patch 1.1.2. Let’s take a look at the exciting updates this patch brings:

[list]
[*] Achievements! We know that many of you have been eagerly awaiting this feature. We're excited to be able to recognise and celebrate your strategic triumphs, and this is the perfect way to do just that!
[*] Your train cards now move down to indicate that it's not your turn.
[*] More consistent button placement when claiming routes, to ensure the buttons are never offscreen.
[*] New turn timer visuals!
[*] Tweaked turn timer durations (blitz and async modes).
[*] Added a greater variety of trains to the main menu animation.
[*] The destination ticket display will now respect the fact that stations can only be used to share a single route when marking tickets as completed with stations.
[*] Memory and performance optimisations for the main menu.
[*] Fixed a camera zoom issue when resuming a game.
[*] Fixed various lobby issues which caused some users problems when their internet connection was unstable
[*] Fixed reconnection issues which sometimes caused problems for opponents 
[/list]

Thank you for being part of our community! We're excited to share the upcoming adventures with you!

notes.title: Patch Version 1.1.0
notes.notes:
Hello, travellers!

We’re excited to bring you the latest update for Ticket to Ride, featuring several fixes and improvements based on your valuable feedback. As always, thank you for your active engagement in the community!

[h3]This update includes:
[/h3]
[list]
[*] New camera controls! Experience the game from every angle and take control by zooming in and out on the map.
[*] AI opponents can now be added to Online With Friends (OWF) mode again.
[*] Added greater map pin variety to handle cases where a player has lots of incomplete destination tickets.
[*] Enhanced track colours so they can be more easily seen on the maps. 
[*] Fixes for disconnection issues in multiplayer games.
[*] Fixes for issues causing game interruptions and invalid moves.
[*] Improved handling of network issues mid-game for seamless reconnection.
[*] Fixes to lobby-related issues, including colour conflicts and incorrect status text.
[*] Improved AI behaviour, specifically in the Europe map.
[*] Fixes for an issue preventing players from reopening their destination tickets panel.
[*] Fixes for issues with bubble chat, friend requests and invites.
[/list]
That's all for now, but our work continues! We look forward to your ongoing participation on our community forums and [url=https://discord.com/invite/8HsaNapn6d]Discord[/url] as we strive to make Ticket to Ride the best it can be.

notes.title: Patch Version 1.0.18
notes.notes:
Greetings, travellers!

We've been closely listening to your concerns regarding multiplayer disconnection issues, and we want to assure you that your feedback is incredibly valuable to us. In response to these concerns, we've temporarily disabled AI opponents in Online With Friends (OWF) games to isolate and address this issue. This measure aims to enhance the overall stability of the game as we work on a fix.

[h3]This update includes:
[/h3]
[list]
[*] Temporary deactivation of AI opponents in Online With Friends games.
[/list]
We genuinely appreciate your patience and understanding during this process. Your support means the world to us.

We encourage you to continue sharing your thoughts. If you encounter any issues or have suggestions, please contact us via the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2477010/discussions/]Community Hub[/url] or our [url=https://discord.com/invite/8HsaNapn6d]Discord server[/url].

notes.title: Patch Version 1.0.17
notes.notes:
Hello, travellers! We're excited to bring you the latest updates and fixes to Ticket to Ride. Here's a breakdown of what’s new in this patch:

[h3]Bug Fixes:
[/h3]
[list]
[*] Making sure players can see the results of async games that ended while they weren't online.
[*] Fixed the issue with AI attempting to pick a card from an invalid card pile.
[*] Fixed an issue with quick game mode which could put you into an empty game.
[*] Fixed several issues that could cause disconnections for players in multiplayer mode. 
[*] Fixed the issue that could prevent you from re-entering a game where one of your opponents had previously disconnected.
[*] Fixed several issues that could result in illegal moves being recorded in multiplayer matches.
[*] Fixed several issues that could result in moves being made for the player before their timer has expired.
[*] Fixed several issues that could cause the game to get stuck at initial ticket selection.
[*] Fixed issues with the previous resign logic implementation.
[/list]
As always, thank you for your support and feedback! We invite you to continue sharing your thoughts, suggestions, and experiences on our community forums or via our [url=https://discord.com/invite/8HsaNapn6d]Discord server[/url].

notes.title: Patch Version 1.0.16
notes.notes:
Hello, travellers!

We're excited to bring you a new update. Thank you for your ongoing support and feedback!

[h3]Here's what's new in version 1.0.16:
[/h3][list]
[*] Implemented extra logging capabilities to help us identify and address issues related to connectivity more effectively.
[*] Reverted specific fixes that inadvertently caused crashes in the game's front end, particularly with notifications in the "My Games" section, impacting the overall stability.
[/list]We will continue to work diligently behind the scenes, conducting thorough quality assurance testing and actively addressing any issues that may arise. We genuinely appreciate your patience and understanding during this time.

notes.title: Patch Version 1.0.15
notes.notes:
Greetings, travellers!

Thank you for consistently reporting any bugs you find in Ticket to Ride – we've been hard at work addressing these key issues for you. We're pleased to introduce some updates in this latest submission build. 

[h3]Improvements:
[/h3]
[list]
[*] Show Player Info Toggle: The "Show Player Info" toggle is now fully functional. Easily view player information at your convenience and strategize your moves with clarity.
[*] Turn Notifications in "My Games": Players will now receive timely notifications in the "My Games" section, reminding them when it's their turn to make their move.
[*] Improved Softlock Errors: We've made improvements in addressing softlock errors during initial ticket selection.
[*] Reduced Start-of-Game Issues: While the issue of players getting stuck at the start with only the settings button visible is still present for some users, we've lowered the reproducibility rate in this new build. You should encounter this less frequently. Our team remains dedicated to further addressing and resolving this matter.
[/list]
We appreciate your patience and dedication as we strive to make your experience the best it can be. 

We'll see you on the tracks!

notes.title: Patch Version 1.0.14
notes.notes:
Hello, travellers!

We've been attentively listening to your feedback and understand that some of you are experiencing gameplay and visual issues that have been affecting your experience. Your insights are crucial to us, and we want to assure you that your concerns have not gone unnoticed. We appreciate the patience and understanding you've demonstrated during these times. 

In this update, we've focused on addressing some of the key issues that have been raised, and while we acknowledge there's still work to be done, we believe this release takes a significant step towards improving your overall gaming experience.

[h3]Improvements:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Resolved a persistent issue causing games to get stuck at initial ticket selection in all modes.
[*] Fixed AI players occasionally selecting fewer than 2 starting tickets when playing on the Europe map.
[/list]
In the upcoming sprint, our development team is committed to tackling more gameplay-related bugs. We are initiating a comprehensive process of reproducing the bugs reported by our community to gather detailed logs and prioritise fixes. 

Your feedback has been instrumental in guiding our efforts. We appreciate your continued patience and understanding as we work towards delivering a smoother and more polished gaming experience.

Thank you for your support!

notes.title: Patch Version 1.0.13
notes.notes:
Hello, travellers!

Thank you for engaging with us and sending your suggestions. As always we are humbled by your support and are committed to delivering the best possible Ticket to Ride experience. We are aware of issues affecting some users in multiplayer and we are continuing to work hard to fix them. 

[h3]This update includes:[/h3]

- Multiplayer stability improvements and fixes
- Operational stability improvements
- Bubble friend invite fixes
- Bubble Push Notifications enabled
- Google Sign-in for Bubble fixes
- UI Polishes
